title: RepliClaw benchmark case manifest
description: Pins one benchmark case: where it comes from, the exact bytes it was run against, and its stratification labels. ground_truth is an EVALUATOR-ONLY pointer (path or URI, never the content itself); lane code must not dereference it outside the scorer.

case_id.description: OBSERVATION (J-CODE W1 F1 / J-SCI W1 S1): upstream RCAEval case identifiers embed the root-cause service (e.g. re1ob_adservice_mem_1) and data files are named by case id. The V3 agent runtime must therefore assign its own opaque random case ids to agents and keep this upstream id evaluator-side only.

pinned_sha.description: Upstream commit SHA (40-hex) or content SHA-256 (64-hex) the case was extracted from.

data_hashes.description: Relative data-file name -> sha256 hex. Must cover every file the lane reads at runtime.

heldout.description: True for cases withheld from any design/tuning feedback.

ground_truth.description: EVALUATOR-ONLY: pointer to ground truth. Never embed the ground-truth content here.

pointer.description: Path or URI to the ground-truth file.
